'''Sevlana Meseau''' is a well-known, historical and legendary [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]] who Merana thought of as impressive.{{Ref|{{twotc}}, Sevlana Meseau}} In fact when [[Bera]] and [[Kiruna]] find themselves confronted with [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]], [[Merana]] thinks that it must be like herself meeting [[Alind Dyfelle]], Sevlana Meseau or [[Mabriam en Shereed]].
